request.description:
Purpose: Read my cached course statistics

Role: trainer. Expected HTTP 200.

Trainer only; admins and learners receive 403. Reads the latest successful global statsRefresh execution by finishedAt, without running a refresh. Check refreshedAt for staleness. Includes all current owned courses regardless of publication status; courses absent from the snapshot receive zero metrics. Enrollment metrics include every enrollment status. Without a successful snapshot, returns HTTP 200 with dataAvailable false, refreshedAt null and an empty courses array.

Purpose: Run inactiveLearnerReminder

Role: admin. Expected HTTP 200.

Admin only. Executes inactiveLearnerReminder synchronously and records its execution. No request body required.
